mapping_policy: Source and acceptance rows were manually reconciled to Rust responsibility boundaries. Test/fixture owners name their semantic target; test_harness/fixture_reader name the shared testkit. Mapping does not imply implementation or acceptance.

target_architecture.crates/doc: Lossless Markdown/YAML/link/Canvas/Bases document models and source transforms.
target_architecture.crates/vault: Root-scoped IO, revisions, journaled writes, recovery, history, merge, rename, attachments and watchers.
target_architecture.crates/engine: Cross-document workflows, indexing, graph/retrieval, AI/provider orchestration, approvals and Chronicle workflows.
target_architecture.crates/platform: OS dialogs/clipboard/file-open, app preferences, credential store and OS storage protection.
target_architecture.crates/plugins: Bounded extension runtime, legacy compatibility evaluation, capability policy, preview broker and artifact evidence.
target_architecture.crates/ui-egui: Native eframe/egui shell, editing/workspace/navigation, previews and interactive workflows.
target_architecture.crates/testkit: Synthetic vaults, golden fixtures, fault injection and shared test support.
target_architecture.xtask: Layering, CI inventory/contracts, release, license and evidence tools.
